answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 91 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a horizon bet on surviving 91 epochs of grading, and every vertex settlement recomputes the velvet schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
